LanguageData.UFR_GrinderIdle: Idle. Add the "grind ferrocrete slurry" process, place hoppers with stone blocks and steel on its left and right, and connect a slurry vat.
LanguageData.UFR_KilnIdle: Not firing. Needs power and a slurry network with stored slurry.
LanguageData.UFR_FerrocreteValveDesc: Open or close the valve to allow or block ferrocrete slurry flow. A pawn will come to switch it.
